text: {"final": {"summary": "P1: created scripts/resend_failed_sms.py, an ops script whose docstring states it sends SMS. It loads sent_messages() and delivery_status(), selects only messages whose id maps to 'failed', and for each appends a new SmsMessage to data/outbox/sms.jsonl via append_jsonl — copying household_id, phone (from the original outbox line, not the registry), template_id, params and text from the original, with a fresh id via format_sms_id(next_number(...)) recomputed as records are appended (SMS-00022..SMS-00031) and queued_at from config.settings.now(). It does not call queue_sms, so no registry lookup or sms_ok check is applied, and delivered/no-status messages are skipped. P2: ran the script once; it appended exactly 10 resend records for the 10 failed messages (SMS-00001, 00004, 00005, 00006, 00009, 00010, 00012, 00018, 00019, 00020) to the 10 listed households. Verified with a read-only check script: the outbox gained exactly 10 lines with sequential ids SMS-00022..SMS-00031, each new line copies household_id/phone/template_id/params/text from its failed original, and no delivered household received a line.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
